about: App Store frames. Store scenes (StoreScenesUITests) photographs each set's scenes in the App Store build on the review demo kitchen; scripts/store-frames/render.mjs puts each scene in its frame with the caption here. Every caption must stay true of the build it ships with (Guideline 2.3). The first three shots of a set are the ones search results show. A set's keep files are art no scene makes yet (the iPhone Duo spread), copied from distribution/app-store/screenshots as they are.
